author: private-a2
name: Q01
source:
theorem Q01 : ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := by
  intro a b c x ha hb
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (2*a*x+b)^2 := Int.sq_nonneg _
  have h2 : 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) = (2*a*x+b)^2 + (4*a*c - b^2) := by
    grind
  have h3 : 0 ≤ 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := by
    rw [h2]; omega
  have h4 : 0 < 4*a := by omega
  exact Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h3 h4
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c

author: private-a2
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN hS hDD
  have h1 : m.S*M*N ≤ m.Du*m.Dv*N*N := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hN
    grind
  have h2 : 0 < M*M := Int.mul_pos hM hM
  have h3 : 0 < m.detJ*(M*M) := Int.mul_pos hd h2
  have e : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*(M*M) - m.S*M*N + m.Du*m.Dv*N*N := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [e]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-a2
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hd hp hD hS n hn
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    unfold Scope.modeM
    grind
  have hn' : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hk : 1 ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn' hn' (by omega) (by omega)
    grind
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv * s^2) * ((n:Int)^2 - 1) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hD (Int.sq_nonneg s)) (by omega)
  have h2 : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM Scope.modeN
    grind
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ hd hM hN h2 hD)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-a2
name: H02
source:
theorem H02 : ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B := by
  intro r B C
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B

name: H04
source:
theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h1 h2
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

author: private-a2
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M hd hu hv hM hN hneg
  have hP : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos hu hv
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hM hM
    grind
  have hdM : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos hd hM2
  have key : m.modeDet N M = (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + (-(m.S * M)) * N + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Scope.Model.modeDet, Scope.Model.S, Scope.Model.detJ]
    grind
  constructor
  · apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h
    have hS : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (N * M) * (-m.S) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN (Int.le_of_lt hM)) (by omega)
    have hN2 : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt hP) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
    grind
  · apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h
    have h' : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := by omega
    have h2 : m.S ^ 2 * M ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ * M ^ 2 :=
      Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h' (Int.le_of_lt hM2)
    have h4 := Q01 (m.Du * m.Dv) (-(m.S * M)) (m.detJ * M ^ 2) N hP (by grind)
    grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2
